task_summary: Bound xterm renderers with visible and warm LRU cache

spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Implement Ferryx terminal renderer lifetime scaling after the output-batching implementation is complete.
DELIVERABLE: Modify `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.ts`, `ui/src/lib/terminalHostManager.test.ts`, and `ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx` only as needed to enforce visible-only renderers plus a bounded LRU warm cache. Return exact changed paths, RED/ GREEN output, and an explanation of PTY preservation and inactive output behavior.
SCOPE: You depend on the preceding output-batching node: inspect its final code rather than overwriting it. Do not modify workspace state, Rust, remote/mobile protocol, tab drag/drop/layout code, or package manifests. Preserve existing unrelated dirty edits.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: All mounted split panes are pinned visible and never evicted. On an unmounted pane, suspend/unsubscribe its xterm output handling while `TerminalEventBus` continues bounded replay/title/activity processing. Keep a small explicit bounded LRU cache of inactive xterm renderer instances. Evict the least-recently-used inactive renderer by disposing frontend renderer resources and subscriptions only—never close or destroy the associated backend PTY/session. On a warm or recreated renderer becoming visible, reset/replay safely so stale output is not duplicated and replay order precedes live events. Track/cancel pending output scheduling on lifecycle changes. Make the configured warm cache bound independently testable without production-only test hacks.
RED PROOF: Add deterministic host-manager/TerminalPane coverage that initially fails because there is no LRU cap or inactivity suspension. It must create visible split sessions plus more inactive sessions than the configured warm budget, demonstrate the oldest inactive frontend renderer is disposed, visible instances remain, and its backendSessionId/session record is not closed. Run `bun run --cwd ui test -- terminalHostManager` to capture this RED result before implementation.
GREEN PROOF: Implement the smallest strict TypeScript change, run the same tests to green. Include a test showing suspended inactive output is replayed in correct order upon reactivation without direct background terminal writes. No fixed sleeps.
VERIFY: Run diagnostics on each changed TS/TSX file if available and report pre-existing unrelated diagnostic failures distinctly.
STOP WHEN: Renderer budget, visible split pinning, inactivity output suspension/replay, PTY preservation, and RED→GREEN test evidence are complete.
